verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an official embedding SDK for putting the builder inside your SaaS and auto-provisioning users, plus a TypeScript framework for building custom pieces with fast browser reload. Its REST API is key-authenticated, but no official client SDK for that API is evidenced, and probes found no OpenAPI spec to generate one. Missing for 10: official API client SDKs (any language, let alone several), a published OpenAPI spec, SDK reference depth beyond overview pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
